title: Walk Zone Distance Table of the Student Transportation Services Courtesy Permit Fee Schedule
content:
The distance table of the Student Transportation Services courtesy permit fee schedule reads the measured distance on the assignment (the routing system's distance from the residence to the campus) against the walk zone of the rider's school level, and adds an amount to the period rate. The rider's grade is the grade on the student's latest-registered district enrollment record for the school year in Student Enrollment, Transfers and Pre-Kindergarten Admissions (the latest by registration date); a student with no such record has no grade.

**Walk zone of the rider's school level.** 1.00 mile for a rider in grade KG through 05; 1.50 miles for any other grade or no grade.

| Measured distance | Amount added to the period rate, Courtesy Rider Permit (Annual) | Amount added, Courtesy Rider Permit (Semester) |
|---|---|---|
| less than the walk zone | 24.00 USD | 13.50 USD |
| 1.50 miles or more, and not less than the walk zone | a reduction of 24.00 USD (entered in the schedule as -24.00) | a reduction of 13.50 USD (entered as -13.50) |
| any other distance, or no measured distance on the assignment | nothing | nothing |

## Both sides of each figure (hypothetical riders)

| Rider | Measured distance | Result on an annual permit |
|---|---|---|
| grade 03 | 0.99 mile | 24.00 added |
| grade 03 | 1.00 mile | nothing |
| grade 03 | 1.49 miles | nothing |
| grade 03 | 1.50 miles | 24.00 taken off |
| grade 08 | 1.49 miles | 24.00 added |
| grade 08 | 1.50 miles | 24.00 taken off |
